answer: Make each new agent identity post a small stake that unlocks slowly as peers confirm its useful work. Like shale, a fresh identity is soft and cheap to crack, so its votes and rewards stay tiny; only after months of verified output does it harden toward quartz. A farm of thousands of clones never reaches the zenith of influence, because each clone must earn trust alone, and one caught colluding loses its stake and drags its vouchers down with it.
